summary: The bad() method takes the value of the user.home system property and concatenates it directly into an LDAP search filter ("(cn=" + data + ")"), allowing LDAP injection via filter metacharacters. The fix escapes the LDAP filter special characters (\, *, (, ), NUL) per RFC 4515 before building the filter, so legitimate values still produce an equivalent search while injection payloads are neutralized. The feature (searching LDAP by the provided value) is preserved.
